title: Roger E. Koontz Fellowship in Law and Climate Policy
description:
Acadia Center is seeking motivated law students to apply for its Roger E. Koontz Fellowship in Law and Climate Policy. The Koontz Fellow will work with Acadia Center staff - attorneys, policy experts, researchers, and communications professionals - on legal projects that directly advance the organization's work. Depending on the assignment, the Fellow may have the opportunity to meet with policymakers, attend public meetings, and engage in coalition interactions. Projects will be assigned based on skills and interests and could encompass one or more of the following areas of focus:

•
Energy Regulatory System Reform Researching legal issues and policy solutions on issues relating to the need to reform approaches to regional power grid and state-level utility planning, financing, and governance to advance clean energy, climate, consumer, and energy justice goals;

•
Clean Energy and Community Engagement Scoping issues for legal and policy review related to community and stakeholder engagement in the anticipated expansion of regional and interregional clean energy projects, power grid, and transmission, such as a review of the adequacy of current permitting processes to seek and engage community-level input;

•
Building Energy and Energy Justice Undertaking legal analysis supported by data to advance organizational initiatives on energy efficiency and building decarbonization to better understand the connections between energy equity and environmental justice issues, and to develop policy recommendations for housing and transportation/mobility;

•
Legislative/Statutory Analysis Examining federal and state laws to assess existing authority to advance policies to develop clean energy resources, transmission, cap GHG emissions or trade emissions allowances;

•
Regulatory Intervention Support Providing legal support for regulatory interventions through discovery, interrogatory requests, testimony drafting, and more, in policy dockets, rate cases, and other adjudicated proceedings before state Public Utilities Commissions;

•
Clean Energy Procurement Undertaking legal analysis and advocacy in regional settings of multi-state procurements for clean energy resources, or regional procurements for public policy transmission upgrades, supporting Acadia Center analysis of Requests for Proposals, contracts, and ISO New England tariffs filed before the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, for their impact on costs, reliability, emissions reductions, equity, and beyond.

Requirements
Applicants should be currently enrolled in an ABA-accredited law school and have completed at least one full year of law school in good standing before the fellowship begins. Demonstrated interest in environmental, energy, administrative, or public-interest law is preferred. Strong research, writing, and analytical skills are required.
The Fellow will work under the supervision of a licensed attorney. Applicants should submit a résumé, cover letter, law-school transcript, and writing sample.
Benefits
The Koontz Fellow position is fully remote, though there may be possibilities for in-person connections near Acadia Center staff locations in Rockport, ME; Boston, MA; Providence, RI; Hartford, CT; and New York City.
The fellowship is expected to run full-time for 8-10 weeks in June, July, and August and can be structured as full or flex time. Acadia Center will provide a stipend of up to $8,000-$13,000 (full-time level), depending on factors such as educational level, background experience, and schedule.
Applicants are encouraged to seek support from other school or work support programs, such as those offered by the Massachusetts Clean Energy Center (MassCEC) and the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA).

description:
About the Team

OpenAI's Marketing team helps people understand and use AI responsibly. We work with Research, Product, Design, Communications, and Creative to turn complex capabilities into clear stories, useful examples, and experiences that help audiences understand what the technology can do.

About the Role

As a Research Product Marketing Manager, you will help translate OpenAI's research into accurate positioning, compelling demonstrations, and launch narratives. You will work closely with researchers and product teams to understand new capabilities, the evidence behind them, and their limitations, then explain why they matter to the audiences we want to reach.

You will connect technical understanding with audience insight, carrying work from the initial brief through launch and follow-through. This is a hands-on role for a marketer who can ask precise questions, write clearly, and help teams make sound decisions as research and product plans evolve.

In this role, you will:

- Develop positioning and messaging for research capabilities and releases, grounding claims in evidence and clearly distinguishing demonstrated results from possible applications.

- Partner with researchers and product leads to understand how capabilities work, where they are useful, and what limitations or caveats audiences need to know.

- Define priority audiences and questions for each initiative. Use research, feedback, and usage signals to identify barriers to understanding and opportunities for useful adoption.

- Build launch briefs that connect the research story, audience needs, communications goals, and the work required from cross-functional partners.

- Work with Creative, Design, and technical collaborators on demonstrations, examples, and educational content that make complex ideas understandable without overstating performance.

- Coordinate messaging and launch materials with Research, Product, Communications, and other relevant review partners, keeping descriptions consistent as plans change.

- Turn audience feedback and launch results into recommendations for clearer explanations, stronger examples, and sustained education beyond the initial announcement.

- Establish measures of audience understanding, engagement, and adoption with analytical partners, and communicate findings with appropriate limits and practical next steps.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have experience in product marketing or a related role bringing technical products, research, or emerging capabilities to market.

- Can learn unfamiliar technical concepts, ask useful questions of subject-matter experts, and translate their answers for audiences with different levels of expertise.

- Write clear positioning, briefs, and launch materials that make a persuasive case while preserving technical accuracy and necessary nuance.

- Have taken cross-functional launches or educational programs from an ambiguous brief through delivery and measurement.

- Use qualitative research and quantitative signals to shape messaging and priorities rather than relying on assumptions about what audiences need.

- Build productive relationships with research, product, creative, and communications partners, and can align contributors without formal authority.

- Exercise sound judgment with confidential work, evolving results, and shifting timelines. Experience with AI products or research-led organizations is valuable.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. title: Veterinary AI Expert
description:
About CoVet

CoVet is an AI copilot and scribe built to assist veterinary professionals by saving them time and allowing them to focus more on pet care-or even get home on time. We are a small, passionate, and agile team with a strong mission to improve the veterinary industry through innovative technology.

As we scale, we are looking for a forward-thinking Veterinary AI Expert to join our CoVet Medical Team and help us advance both the performance and personalization of our AI solutions.

About the role

As a Veterinary AI Expert , you will combine your veterinary expertise with your passion for AI and technology to shape the future of our AI Copilot. Reporting directly to the CVO, you will work closely with our users to understand their unique workflows, create custom templates and prompt strategies, and collaborate with our technical teams to test, train, and refine new AI models. This role also involves structuring internal systems for testing AI performance, researching emerging solutions in the market, and influencing the next generation of features in the CoVet platform.

You will also support our user community, contribute to research initiatives, and help create educational content that bridges the gap between veterinary practice and AI-driven innovation.

What you'll do

• Develop and customize templates and prompts within the CoVet app tailored to users across diverse veterinary practice areas.

• Design and test new prompting strategies to improve the performance and relevance of the AI Copilot across specialties.

• Collaborate directly with technical teams to provide veterinary insight during the development and refinement of new AI tools and implementations.

• Contribute to the design of internal testing systems to evaluate AI behavior, accuracy, and performance in clinical contexts.

• Research and evaluate emerging AI tools, platforms, and market solutions to inform product development strategy.

• Occasionally provide expert-level support to users, troubleshoot AI-related issues, and help train users to maximize the value of the Copilot.

• Participate in or co-lead academic and clinical research projects focused on veterinary AI applications.

• Influence the long-term roadmap and enhancements of the CoVet platform with a strong voice for veterinary user needs.

Qualifications

• 3-5 years of experience as a Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) in any clinical setting.

• Hands-on or collaborative experience with AI systems, prompt engineering, or machine learning tools (formal or informal).

• Experience with software testing, QA, or structured evaluation of digital tools is a plus.

• Background in customer support or client-facing roles is considered an asset.

Skills:

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to design practical, scalable solutions.

• Comfort navigating ambiguity and developing systems or processes from the ground up.

• Excellent communication and documentation skills-especially the ability to convey complex tech ideas clearly.

• Self-driven and organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced startup environment.

• Curiosity and a strong interest in the intersection of technology and medicine.

Education:

• Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM or equivalent) degree required.

Why Join Us?

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• A dynamic and creative remote work environment.

• Opportunity to work in an exciting, fast-paced industry and help shape the future of veterinary technology.

If you are a passionate veterinarian with a keen interest in AI and technology, and you're excited about making a significant impact on the veterinary industry, we'd love to hear from you!

CoVet is proud to be an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds. Adjustments are available throughout the recruitment process to accommodate individual needs.
